hardware.notes: Kyle's location deployed: Pi 4B + Pi OS Lite 64-bit + Wayfire (Wayland) + Chromium kiosk pointed at Vercel URL. Supabase session persists in Chromium profile across reboots. Pi is just a display client — all state in Supabase cloud.

features.name: Data Layer / Backend
features.notes: App owns all data — no external calendar API. Supabase (PostgreSQL) is the source of truth. Realtime subscriptions push changes instantly to all connected clients. No polling.

features.name: Authentication
features.notes: Supabase Auth with @supabase/ssr. Phase 1: single shared family login. Phase 2: per-user accounts planned.

features.name: Calendar Views
features.notes: Three view types: HourlyGrid (hourly-auto/day/week — time-positioned blocks), SummaryGrid (daily-auto/month — day boxes + spanning bars), Schedule (chronological agenda list). Split-button picker in CalendarInfoBar with Clock/LayoutGrid/List icons (lucide-react). daily-auto: computeDailyAutoWeeks() formula-based row height (spanBarH + dayOverhead + maxDayEvents × tileH) with ResizeObserver; shows max weeks fitting without scroll; default view on load. month: paper-calendar style — out-of-month cells darker bg + hide events/weather; past in-month cells dimmed. CalendarView type: 'hourly-auto'|'day'|'week'|'daily-auto'|'month'|'schedule'.

features.name: Event CRUD
features.notes: Full create/edit/delete via modals. Events support: title, description, location, timed or all-day, multi-member assignment, house tag for Household events. EventModal UX: stacked datetime inputs (no AM/PM clipping), start-time change auto-adjusts end to maintain duration.

features.name: Per-Member Filtering
features.notes: Filter chips with dual click zones: avatar = solo mode (show only this person), body = toggle. Compact 4-column grid on mobile, full chip row on desktop. Holidays chip removed from main view; controlled via Settings toggle instead.

features.name: Parenting / Custody Schedule
features.notes: 7 or 14-day repeating pattern with per-day toggle in settings. One-off overrides supported. Custody overlay renders as background color on both HourlyGrid and SummaryGrid views.

features.name: Weather Widget
features.notes: Open-Meteo (free, no API key). 16-day daily forecast shown in day headers. Clicking opens hourly detail modal with precip probability. Lat/lon configured in Settings. Weather hidden on out-of-month days in month view.

features.name: Responsive Mobile Layout
features.notes: Bottom nav on mobile, left sidebar on desktop. Compact filter chips, color-only event tiles in summary views. Tested on iPhone via Tailscale + iPad.

features.name: PWA / Installable
features.notes: PWA manifest, generated icons (192/512px), Apple touch icon. Installable on phones from Vercel URL.

features.name: Device Identity + PIN System
features.notes: Device identity via UUID in localStorage → device_settings DB row per device (house, theme, density, show_holidays, weather lat/lon). useDeviceSettings hook; seeds localStorage from DB on load (Pi reboot recovery). PIN per parent (Kyle/Mel): HMAC-SHA256 server-side with PIN_SALT env var; /api/pin/verify + /api/pin/set; useAdminSession hook. Active parent in sessionStorage. Settings page rewritten with sticky header tabs (This Device / Family) + always-visible unlock buttons. Supabase Auth single shared login still protects Vercel URL. Decision: device identity chosen over per-Supabase-Auth-account-per-parent.

features.name: Household Event House Filtering
features.notes: event.house ('kyle'|'mel'|'both'|null) compared against deviceSettings.house in CalendarTab. null/both show everywhere; kyle/mel only show on matching device house; shared devices see all. Filtered before any view receives events.

features.name: SummaryGridView Three Rendering Modes
features.notes: useIsMobile hook (matchMedia ≤767px) separate from compact density preference. Mobile: text overlays on tiles, child color stripes fill full width for multi-child, no parent indent, compact padding, all events shown (no 4-event cap). Desktop compact: normal text flow in flex, ml-4 indent, w-2 right child bands. Desktop spacious: full layout, ml-5 indent, w-3 bands, time labels. Mobile-specific behavior gates on isMobile, not compact.

features.name: Recurring Events
features.notes: App-native recurrence — no rrule dependency. Custom rule schema stored as JSONB in event_series table. Individual occurrence rows generated on demand. Scope dialog for edit/delete (this/following/all). Series cleanup on 'following' delete. Ships in Phase 2.

features.name: Theme System (Design Tokens + Light/Dark)
features.notes: 16-token CSS custom property system (added --past token). All components use semantic tokens. Light theme via [data-theme='light'] attribute overrides. Anti-flash script in <head>. useTheme hook with localStorage. Settings → Appearance toggle. Light-color tile border via isLightColor() + LIGHT_TILE_BORDER for near-white tiles (Family slate-200, Mel yellow).

features.name: Compact / Spacious Layout Density
features.notes: useLayoutDensity hook persists to localStorage. Compact mode reduces: filter chip height, event tile min-height (22px vs 48px), parent/child band widths, date number size, weather icon size, inter-tile gap, day cell bottom padding. Settings → Appearance toggle.

features.name: Long-press Day Tile → Add Event
features.notes: 500ms long-press on SummaryGridView day cells opens add-event modal pre-filled with tapped date. makeLongPressHandlers() factory pattern avoids calling hooks in .map() loops. Cancels on pointer-up or pointer-leave. Context menu suppressed.

features.name: Past Day Visual Distinction
features.notes: --past CSS token: #090e1a dark / #e8edf2 light. Past day cells get bg-past background. Past day content gets opacity-60. Custody overlay uses gradient layering (linear-gradient as image layer over --past var). Alpha: 0.12 past / 0.15 future so past days recede.

features.name: Drag Gestures (HourlyView)
features.notes: Drag-to-create: click-drag on empty HourlyView area opens add-event modal pre-filled with dragged time range. Drag-to-reschedule: drag existing event tile to new time slot, updates optimistically then PATCHes API. Shift-drag copies the event to the new slot (POST). Separate EditState machine tracking DragPhase internals. Touch and mouse pointer events both handled.

features.name: Click-to-Select + Action Panel
features.notes: Click event tile in SummaryGridView to select it (blue inset ring). Floating action panel appears anchored near tile with Details/Edit/Delete buttons (position: fixed, clamped to viewport). Shift+click for multi-select. SelectionToolbar for 2+ selected events. Delete/Backspace keyboard shortcut. Delete toast with 4s undo window — optimistic removal, flushPendingDelete() fires actual API calls, Undo cancels timer and restores events via restoreEventsLocal().

features.name: US Holidays Import
features.notes: Imports US public holidays from Nager.Date free API (3 years: current + 2 ahead). POST /api/holidays/sync deduplicates by date, inserts events at noon UTC (all_day=true), links to Holidays member. Holidays member color lightened to #e07a94. Settings page: show/hide toggle (show_holidays DB column, default true) + Sync button with status message. Holidays chip removed from main calendar filter row.

features.name: Wheeler Bank
features.notes: Full family banking app within the calendar. PIN-based login (separate from calendar auth). Admins (Kyle/Mel) see all members with total balances; children see their own accounts only. Per-child accounts: Spending (withdrawals, transfers, interest), Mission Savings (no withdrawals, higher APR), up to 3 Special Savings (goal-locked, locked until goal met, then Transfer to Spending). Configurable APR per account type (admin-only Interest Rates modal). Daily compounding interest via pg_cron + generate_series. Completed savings count toward Spending balance for interest purposes. Admin can add/edit/delete transactions; special savings have deposit caps and withdrawal guards. Transfer-to-Spending fires confetti animation + card pulse. Mobile layout: single scroll container on mobile, sticky account tabs in admin view, Completed Goals stacks below transactions on mobile. Wheeler Bank PNG icon in nav, admin header, and login screen. Colors fetched dynamically from calendar members table.

features.name: In-App Virtual Keyboard
features.notes: VirtualKeyboardContext + VirtualKeyboard component. QWERTY (data-vk) and numpad (data-vk-num) modes. onPointerDown={e=>e.preventDefault()} prevents input blur on key tap. numpadStrRef tracks intermediate numeric strings ('-', '5.') that browsers reject as valid type='number' values. Gated on device_settings.virtual_keyboard boolean per device. Wired to EventModal, Settings, and all Bank modals.

features.name: Pi Kiosk Setup
features.notes: Pi 4B + Pi OS Lite 64-bit + Wayfire (Wayland compositor) + Chromium kiosk mode pointed at Vercel URL. 27" QHD 1440p IPS 100Hz display. Supabase session persists in Chromium profile across reboots. Kyle's location deployed; Mel's location pending.
